placements.why: Both segments describe an E2E test that reproduces a production failure pattern and asserts correct behavior — this is proof-grain organizational content, and no existing strata category exists yet.
placements.title: Validation through reproduction
placements.theme: Production failure patterns are reproduced in controlled tests to prove the system handles them correctly.

placements.title: Generate rather than crash when identifiers are absent
placements.theme: When a markdown heading arrives without an expected id field, the system must derive a valid slug and continue rather than crashing.
placements.why: src-1 identifies the production failure pattern — a ## heading with no id field — and src-2 states the behavioral contract: no crash, valid slug output. Together they support a narrative about graceful degradation when expected identifiers are missing, a theme future envelopes testing edge-case handling will keep feeding.
